Zara Mitchell: Final preflight for marketplace + partner GTM. Launch scheduled Thu 08:00 UTC. Quick status: press embargo, partner assets, SI quickstart, and listing metadata. Anything blocking?

Diego Alvarez: From partnerships: NovaGrid (HW) approved wording but asked we change 'accelerated on NovaGrid' -> 'validated on NovaGrid hardware' until certification. They've also requested a small partner CTA to their benchmarking page.

Hannah Cho: Marketing: press list ready, but need partner PR contacts for consolidated embargo. Also need three short hero quotes; can we use short lines from early access SIs? Legal needs written permission.

Eli Turner: Docs: SI quickstart uploaded to docs.redwood.com/marketplace/si-quickstart. Missing the sample terraform outputs block. Small snippet below for the "Deploy" tab: 
```
output "marketplace_url" {
  value = azurerm_marketplace_offer.example.marketplace_url
}
```

partner-bot: Reminder: migration window Wed 23:00-23:45 UTC. Runbook: runbooks/marketplace-publish.md.

Zara Mitchell: Action items: 1) Diego to confirm partner PR contacts and logo variants. 2) Hannah to finalize press draft and collect legal approvals for quotes. 3) Eli to add terraform outputs and a troubleshooting bullet. 4) Ops to run smoke tests during migration window.

Diego Alvarez: I'll push logo variants (svg/png) and loop NovaGrid PR. If logo approval delayed, we'll use partner spotlight-only copy and swap later.

Hannah Cho: I'll send embargo copy to partner PRs once I get contacts. Press send planned 48h before launch.

Eli Turner: Added troubleshooting bullet and terraform snippet to the doc. Also set feature flag gate: marketplace_listing_live=false until post-migration.

Zara Mitchell: Good. Next sync tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Callout: keep any embargo questions in this thread only. :megaphone:
